title: PostgreSQL session left idle in transaction beyond operational threshold
customer_impact: No broad customer failure is present yet, but one application transaction remains open and retains database resources/locks longer than the operational baseline, creating elevated risk for future contention and maintenance interference.
scope: One named simulated application session is idle in transaction. PostgreSQL remains reachable, no lock-waiting customer session is required for diagnosis, and unrelated application traffic remains available.

timeline.event: Long-transaction signal identified an application session exceeding the exercise age threshold.
L2 acknowledged the P3 operational-risk incident and captured pg_stat_activity before any session termination.
Evidence confirmed application_name opsforge-db003-idle-transaction in state idle in transaction with an open xact_start.
Lock inventory and global blocked-session count were captured to distinguish stale transaction state from active lock contention.
Approved simulated recovery targeted only the evidence-matched stale backend.
Verification confirmed the stale session was gone, PostgreSQL remained reachable, and the target row was independently writable.

evidence: application_name uniquely identified the simulated stale session
pg_stat_activity showed state idle in transaction
xact_start and transaction age were captured before remediation
last query and wait event were captured for context
pg_locks inventory was retained before recovery
global blocked-session count was captured to distinguish DB-003 from DB-002 lock contention
only the approved evidence-matched backend was terminated
post-recovery named-session count returned to zero
post-recovery write completed with UPDATE 1 and SELECT 1 confirmed database reachability
resolution: L2 verified one named stale idle-in-transaction session, captured transaction and lock evidence, and used the approved simulated targeted termination. Recovery was proven by disappearance of the stale session, successful independent write validation, and continued database reachability.
